name: Kosmos-1074
about: Kosmos-1074 (1979-008A), a crewed vehicle (7K-ST), launched 1979 Jan 31. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1979 Mar  2), held fixed
GCAT gives no site; the point stands in for the programme's usual landing or recovery area, from memory
